description: The Sprites REPORTERS half, and the name says what the fixture pins: `new_turtle`/`who`/`turtles` are reserved WITHOUT the Sprites profile. All three `define`s raise `ol-reserved-word` under `["core-language", "turtle-rendering"]` -- Sprites, which owns these names, is not claimed; Turtle & Rendering is present only because Sprites depends on it in the profile DAG and this fixture sits in the Sprites tree. Keeping reporters separate from the block-heads (`reserved-procedures-without-sprites`) is deliberate: they reach the built-in-names predicate as registered PRIMITIVES rather than as keywords, so a change that moves one category and not the other still turns this fixture red. `"check": true`: checker diagnostics only, nothing executes. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: this fixture does not set `compareMessages`, so the harness compares its diagnostics on identity alone (issue #1025) -- and supplying a `message` without that flag is now a fixture ERROR rather than silently-ignored data, so nothing can sit here asserting nothing. Diagnostic identity is `code` plus `params` and "prose is presentation" (`spec/error-model.md:254-259`); the learner-facing wording is pinned by unit tests instead.
